title: [finding] The rest of the read-only data-command family exits 1 on a project with no database yet: migrate account-issuer, audit-metadata-bodies, meta --stored, secret orphans and rewrap, storage orphans read tables their boot deferred
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named position**, a `finding` of class (a).
- `reach:` was measured at a public door by the #21529 dev at `b3f7cf99e4` (CLI source unchanged since), on the same absent-database fixture with `--json` (os-dev report on #21529, out-of-scope finding 1; PR #21550).
- Filed by the `domain:cli` seat, `session_016GiHYRmLSNWTfbX9gVQkpz`. ⛔ Not a claim.
- **Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes it. The doors are `packages/cli`.
- This is the family close-out of #20821 (`os migrate plan`) and #21529 (`resume`, `recorded-by`, `value-shapes`), whose ruling named three doors only.

## What happens (measured, public door, a project whose database does not exist yet)

| command | answer |
|---|---|
| `os migrate account-issuer` | exit 1, the read of the account table refused |
| `os migrate audit-metadata-bodies` | exit 1, `failures: 3` (the audit, activity and metadata-audit tables) |
| `os migrate meta --stored` | exit 1, the stored-metadata table refused |
| `os secret orphans` / `os secret rewrap` | exit 1, the secret table refused (`scan_failed`) |
| `os storage orphans` | exit 1, the file table refused |
| `files-to-references`, `summary-nulls`, `multi-value-columns`, `duplicates` | exit 0 (control) |

The cause is the one #21529 fixed for its three doors: the read-only boot defers the DDL, and the command's own first read hits a table the boot deferred.

## Direction (the #21529 ruling `5965283666`, applied to these doors; ⛔ not a ruling here)

- Prefer "not asked": the command does not read a table its boot found missing, and answers empty work with its documented exit. PR #21550 adds the seam for this, `SchemaStack.tableAbsent(objectName)` in `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts`, true only for a table the deferred sync lists as `create_table`. These doors reuse it. ⛔ No second mechanism.
- If a read cannot be avoided, use `isMissingTableError`, only for the command's own deferred table. ⛔ Do not demote every refused read.

## Also for triage (from the same report, a candidate)

Every read-only data-command boot of an absent database prints one `[ObjectQLPlugin] sys_metadata_activation is registered but could not be read — packaged-ACTION enable/disable is UNAVAILABLE` warning. PR #21093 (#20821) kept that line ON PURPOSE and recorded it as a false alarm on a dry run, so it may already be decided. Rule it in or out of this card.

**Serial:** this extends PR #21550's seam, so it starts once that PR lands.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed: 「read-only boot deferred table refused exit 1 secret orphans rewrap storage orphans absent database」 gave 6 hits.
- #21529 (open) is the three-door sibling this extends.
- #21492 (open) concerns the memory driver.
- The other four are closed, on other subjects (#17010, #20768, #7737, #3917).

Dedupe words: read-only boot deferred table refused exit 1; secret orphans rewrap absent database; storage orphans fresh project; meta stored account-issuer audit-metadata-bodies never-booted database.
